description: This file defines data structures, enums, and function prototypes for handling WRP (Wireless Resource Protocol) messages, including serialization, deserialization, and message element extraction. It appears to be a header file used for unit testing stubs related to WRP message processing.

methods.name: wrp_struct_to
methods.description: Converts a wrp_msg_t structure into a byte sequence in a specified format.

methods.name: wrp_to_struct
methods.description: Converts a byte sequence into a wrp_msg_t structure.

methods.name: wrp_struct_to_string
methods.description: Converts a wrp_msg_t structure into a human-readable string.

methods.name: wrp_free_struct
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a wrp_msg_t structure.

methods.name: wrp_pack_metadata
methods.description: Encodes metadata from a data_t structure into a byte buffer.

methods.name: appendEncodedData
methods.description: Appends two encoded buffers into a single buffer, adjusting size accordingly.

methods.name: wrp_get_msg_dest
methods.description: Retrieves the destination address from a wrp_msg_t message.

methods.name: wrp_get_msg_element
methods.description: Extracts a specific element (source/destination) from a wrp_msg_t message.

methods.name: wrp_does_service_match
methods.description: Checks if a service name matches a device ID string.
